scripts.build: npm run generate:api-types && npm run build:backend:go && npm run build --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run generate:api-types && npm run build:backend:go && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend:go && npm run typecheck
scripts.test:backend:go: if not exist apps\backend-go\.gotmp mkdir apps\backend-go\.gotmp && set GOTMPDIR=%cd%\apps\backend-go\.gotmp&& cd apps/backend-go && go test ./...
